stem: A ticketing platform needs to offload heavy reporting reads from the writer and can accept asynchronous replica lag in report data.

choices.text: Create read replicas and route reporting queries to replica endpoints.
Use a Multi-AZ DB instance standby as the reporting query endpoint.
Increase writer instance class and keep all reports on the writer endpoint.
Rely on automated backup snapshots as the reporting read path.

rationale: Read replicas are the intended mechanism for asynchronous read offload. Multi-AZ DB instance standbys support failover but do not serve read traffic. Upsizing the writer can add capacity but does not implement dedicated read offload architecture. Backup snapshots are protection artifacts, not online reporting endpoints.
